EC1: Received any vaccine within a month prior to study vaccine
EC2: Positive serum antibody against Hep B surface antigen [OR] and/or core Hep B core antigen
EC4: For HCV-negative, healthy volunteers: History of HCV infection or positive HCV antibody test
EC5: Participation in another clinical study of an investigational product currently or within the past 90 days, or expected participation during this study
EC6: In the opinion of the investigator, the volunteer is unlikely to comply with the study protocol
EC7: Any clinically significant abnormality or medical history or physical examination including history of immunodeficiency [OR] or autoimmune disease ([NOT] in addition to HCV infection, for HCV group)
EC8: Currently taking systemic steroids [OR] or other immunomodulatory medications including anticancer medications [OR] and antiviral medications
EC9: Any clinically significant acute or chronic medical condition requiring care by a primary care provider (e.g., diabetes [OR], coronary artery disease [OR], rheumatologic illness [OR], malignancy [OR], substance abuse) that, in the opinion of the investigator, would preclude participation
EC10: Unable to continue participation for 156 weeks
EC11: History of previous Hepatitis B vaccination(s)
EC12: Male [OR] or female < 18 and > 62 years of age
EC15: Clinical, laboratory, or biopsy evidence of cirrhosis
